name: switch
title: Switch
description: Binary setting: a two-cell frame whose block stretches to the on side.
whenToUse: Use it for a setting that takes effect the moment it changes. In a form that waits for Save use Checkbox.

parts.name: Switch
parts.description: The binary setting. The thumb STRETCHES between the two halves of the frame (the edge on the travel side leads, the other follows: CSS transitions on the stretch springs' timings). Semantics, keyboard, form value and controlled/uncontrolled state are Base UI Switch's; `onCheckedChange` gets Base UI's event details last. Without children it draws its SwitchThumb.

parts.name: SwitchField
parts.description: Label + description + switch on one row; the row is the hit target. `className` goes to the row's Field.Root; every other prop goes to the Switch.

props.name: layout
props.description: control (default): aligns to a form column. cell: a row inside an enclosing frame (inset text and switch).

parts.name: SwitchThumb
parts.description: The thumb: hollow while off, solid while on.
